text: DEFONEOS — DEFRA Drinking Water Quality AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Index Sitemap DEFONEOS × DEFRA × DRINKING WATER DEFRA Drinking Water Quality AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK drinking water quality — DWI regulation, 48 parameter testing, lead pipe replacement, PFAS monitoring, boil water notices, Cryptosporidium detection, private supplies. 12 entry points × 8 transformation priorities × 6 MCPs. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 6 Red Lines 📋 12 Entry Points Compliance Regulatory Compliance — DWI Monitoring & Enforcement DWI regulates drinking water in England & Wales under Water Industry Act 1991. 48 parameters — microbiological, chemical, metals, pesticides. Compliance % targets per water company. Breach reporting. Enforcement notices, criminal prosecution. Annual compliance report. Water Supply (Water Quality) Regulations 2016. Inspector audit programme. Sampling frequency schedules. Micro Microbiological — E. coli, Crypto, Coliforms E. coli — zero tolerance in treated water. Total coliforms — compliance threshold. Cryptosporidium monitoring — continuous or risk-assessed under SW(SWQ) Regs. Giardia testing. Enterococci at treatment works. Colony counts — 24hr and 72hr. Compliance thresholds per parameter. Risk-based monitoring frequency. Catchment to tap surveillance. Treatment works audit. Distribution sampling programme. Chemical Chemical — Nitrates, Pesticides, THMs, PFAS Nitrate limit 50mg/L — agricultural catchment pressure. Pesticide screening — individual and total. Aluminium, iron, manganese — aesthetic limits. Trihalomethanes — disinfection by-products, 100µg/L. PFAS monitoring — emerging regulatory framework. Lead, copper, nickel — metals compliance. Conductivity, turbidity, colour, pH. Trend analysis across 48 parameters. Seasonal variation tracking. Catchment risk mapping. Lead Lead — Replacement Programme, 10ppb Target Lead pipe replacement programme — 10ppb limit by 2036 target. Current limit 25ppb, tightening to 10ppb. Sampling protocol — random daytime, compliance monitoring points. Priority areas — pre-1970 housing stock. School supply testing programme. Lead communication pipes — company responsibility. Lead service pipes — customer responsibility. Phosphate dosing as interim measure. Community engagement. Replacement scheduling by risk score. Treatment Water Treatment — Coagulation, Filtration, Disinfection Coagulation — aluminium sulphate, ferric chloride dosing. Filtration — rapid gravity sand, GAC, membranes. Disinfection — chlorine, chloramine, UV, ozone. GAC — organic removal. Process optimisation — jar testing, real-time dosing. Chemical cost management. Treatment works condition assessment. Sludge disposal. Energy efficiency. Incident Boil Water Notices — Triggers & Consumer Protection Boil water notice triggers — treatment failure, contamination, supply interruption. Notification within 24hrs. Remediation — flushing, superchlorination. Root cause analysis — DWI investigation. Consumer advice — vulnerable populations, hospitals, schools. Communication — SMS, letter, social media. Incident cost recovery. Lessons learned. Infrastructure Supply Infrastructure — Resilience, Leakage, DMA Network resilience — supply interruptions, burst frequency, pressure zones. DMA management — leakage detection, flow monitoring. Smart metering — consumption data, leak detection. Pressure optimisation — reducing bursts. Trunk main monitoring — SCADA integration. Water Resources 2050. Emergency supply planning. Asset deterioration modelling. Investment prioritisation. Private Private Supplies — Boreholes, Risk Assessment Private supplies — boreholes, springs, wells, group schemes. Local authority monitoring — reg 9, 10, 11 categories. Risk assessment — catchment, treatment, distribution. Enforcement — improvement notices, prohibition. 100,000+ private supplies i
